draw-not-made: The draw has not been made yet. This team’s ties appear here once the tournament starts.
each-map-is-played-twice: Each map is played twice, once from each side. The last map is the decider, played once.
never-played: This team never played a tie. It registered but the draw did not reach it, which is what happens to a roster left unconfirmed.
no-maps-recorded: No maps recorded for this tie.
no-roster-recorded-for-this: No roster recorded for this team.
played-on-uncatalogued: Played on {maps}, which the map catalogue does not carry.
